status: Source reconciled draft; independent clinical, oncology-pharmacy and patient/PPI review pending
material_findings: 00315 requires G-CSF in every cycle; 00323/00324 permit G-CSF and recommend subsequent-cycle prophylaxis after complicated neutropenia.
TPF schedules differ in cisplatin dose, fluorouracil daily dose, infusion duration, cycle number and following treatment; they are not interchangeable.
00332 is AUC1.5 weekly ×7 after induction. 00419/head_neck is AUC2 weekly ×6 and current source is v6. Both sources classify emetogenicity as moderate.
00419 v6 amendment date is 2026-09-23; last review date is 2026-08-04. Its 00419a HNSCC indication wording changed; preserve 00419b cervical context.
00419 identifies unlicensed posology and indication; 00332 identifies unlicensed indication. Consent requires explicit patient-specific discussion of the current licensed/off-label position.
00323/00332 timing-origin discrepancy and 00323 wrong numerical cross-reference must stay visible until clarified.
TAX323 and TAX324 compare TPF with PF induction. They do not prove that adding induction beats chemoradiation alone or quantify an isolated carboplatin effect.

local_support_preservation.note: Preserve the CUH high/moderate and docetaxel proforma adjuncts where applicable: omeprazole, local nystatin/chlorhexidine mouth care, breakthrough antiemetics and loperamide. These are historical local reference items requiring current-policy and patient-specific review, not universal prophylaxis or an additional duplicate prescription.
